title: Ada and the Orchard
author: C. M. Halloran
blurb: Ivo Underhill, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the century turns.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
